name: When should a seller request a Comparative Market Analysis?

mainEntity.name: When should a seller request a Comparative Market Analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: A seller should request a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) ideally before deciding to list their home for sale. This provides a clear understanding of their property's market value and helps set realistic expectations for pricing and potential returns. It is also beneficial to request a CMA if you've been considering selling for a while and market conditions have changed significantly, or if your property hasn't sold within its initial listing period.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sellers should request a CMA before listing their home to understand its market value and set a realistic price.
